import subprocess
# Reset to base temporarily to see which tests pass
result = subprocess.run(["git", "stash"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Stash:", result.stdout, result.stderr)

result = subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "base"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Checkout:", result.stdout, result.stderr)

result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", 
     "tests/test_cache.py", "tests/test_cached.py", "tests/test_cachedmethod.py",
     "tests/test_fifo.py", "tests/test_func.py", "tests/test_keys.py",
     "tests/test_lfu.py", "tests/test_lru.py", "tests/test_mru.py",
     "tests/test_rr.py", "tests/test_tlru.py", "tests/test_ttl.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result.stdout[-5000:])
